info.name: Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Monitoring Hub API
info.description:
Enterprise End-to-End Postman API Collection for Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Monitoring Hub.
Features:
- Authentication & RBAC (Admin, L1, L2)
- Microsoft Entra ID Directory Search
- Admin Setup & Domain SLA Configuration
- Workspaces, Master & Sub-Pipeline Catalogs
- Adaptive Poller & On-Demand Run Triggers
- Continuous SLA Tracking, Multi-Tier Alerting & Auto-Resolution
- Azure OpenAI GPT-4o Error Diagnostics
- Lakehouse/Warehouse Delta Table Telemetry & SQL Endpoints
- WebSocket Live Streaming
